content:
Apple TV is getting into the holiday spirit early, announcing today that two new holiday specials are on the way, along with free viewing offers for several beloved Peanuts classics. Details below.

Brand-new Peanuts and Fraggle Rock holiday specials, a family film starring Chris Pratt, and more are coming to Apple TV

This year, Apple is launching two new holiday specials from two beloved franchises:

  • Snoopy Presents: 12 Days of Snoopy premieres Friday, November 13
  • Fraggle Rock: A Holiday Gift follows on Friday, December 4

Each new film will join Apple TV's existing Peanuts and Fraggle Rock libraries.

In a press release about the holiday rollout, Apple TV is also highlighting a brand-new family-friendly movie, Way of the Warrior Kid. The film premieres Wednesday, November 25, and stars Chris Pratt and Linda Cardellini. While not holiday-themed, Apple likes to release a new family movie around Thanksgiving each year. Here's the synopsis:

Beyond this year's new premieres, Apple will also be offering free viewing of several beloved Peanuts holiday specials during select weekends later this year. The dates:

  • It's the Great Pumpkin, Charlie Brown: October 17-18
  • A Charlie Brown Thanksgiving: November 14-15
  • A Charlie Brown Christmas: December 12-13

Apple TV subscribers can stream these specials anytime throughout the year. But during the above dates, they will be available for free to everyone.

Some additional specials I want to recommend include Apple's musical comedy Spirited, starring Ryan Reynolds and Will Ferrell, as well as Hannah Waddingham: Home for Christmas for Ted Lasso fans.

What are your favorite holiday specials on Apple TV? Let us know in the comments.

Apple TV costs $14.99/month, or you can save with a bundle through Apple One.
